terms.title: PROOF Integrated Service Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: These Terms of Service (hereinafter "Terms") govern the conditions of use, rights and obligations, intellectual property attribution, limitation of liability, dispute resolution, and other necessary matters for the AI-based unstructured data conversion web service and developer API service (hereinafter "Service") provided by Teamcat (hereinafter "Company") to global users through the 'proof.teamcat.app' domain. All computing resources of the Company are operated within infrastructure located in Seoul, Republic of Korea, and the use of the Service and interpretation of these Terms are subject to the laws of the Republic of Korea.
terms.s2Body:
The definitions of key terms used in these Terms are as follows.
"Service" means the web interface and /api/v1/* API through which the Company converts PDFs, audio, video, and images into structured data (CSV, MD, XLSX, etc.) using its own AI language model.
"User" means any individual, corporation, or agent worldwide who agrees to these Terms, creates an account, and uses the Service.
"Input Data" means unstructured information such as PDFs, media files, and text uploaded by the User to the Company's Seoul servers.
"AI Output" means structured tables, text, Excel files, and other processed results generated by the Company's AI inference system based on the User's Input Data.
"Hallucination" means a probabilistic defect phenomenon in which the AI model generates false data not present in the original document or distorts logical connections between text and numbers.
terms.s3Title: Article 3 (Effectiveness, Amendment, and Governing Language of Terms)
terms.s3Body:
The Company publishes these Terms through the service interface or a permanent link. The Company may amend these Terms at any time within the scope not violating mandatory provisions. Amended Terms take effect by being announced alongside the current Terms 7 days before the effective date. However, adverse amendments that restrict User rights or impose cost burdens require a minimum 30-day prior notice period with individual email notification.
The Service supports multiple languages and these Terms may be translated into various languages. However, in case of any discrepancy in interpretation between translated versions, the Korean original shall have absolute and exclusive governing authority and shall be the sole standard for all interpretations.
terms.s4Body:
The Company's official business information and contact channels are as follows. All notices with legal effect, including Terms violation notices and intellectual property infringement reports, must be submitted to the email below to be considered valid.

terms.s5Title: Article 5 (Contract Formation and Account Security Responsibility)
terms.s5Body:
The service contract is formed when an applicant agrees to these Terms, completes registration, and the Company accepts the application. Applicants must be at least 13 years of age or meet the minimum legal age for information collection in their country of residence. Minors under 18 require verifiable consent from a legal guardian.
The User bears full responsibility for maintaining the confidentiality of account credentials (passwords, API keys, etc.). Account credentials may not be shared, lent, or transferred to others. All actions performed through the account credentials are deemed the User's own actions, and the Company is not liable for damages caused by credential leakage.
terms.ch2Title: Chapter 2 Service Architecture Provision and Technical Limitations
terms.s6Title: Article 6 (Asynchronous Processing Architecture and Service Limitations)
terms.s6Body: The Company's file conversion service involves computationally intensive AI inference. To handle this stably, the backend infrastructure operates an asynchronous processing system combining message queues with cache-based storage. Due to this technical characteristic, output delivery is not guaranteed to be immediate, and processing time may vary depending on server resource availability and queue status. The Company makes commercially reasonable best efforts to ensure prompt processing but does not guarantee results within any specific timeframe and is not liable for business schedule delays.
terms.s7Title: Article 7 (Dynamic Routing of Local AI Models and Edge Network Dependency)
terms.s7Body:
The Company operates an architecture that dynamically routes requests among multiple AI model instances at the load balancing and proxy layer for efficient traffic distribution and availability. The User agrees that the Company has the discretion to freely replace, update, or roll back backend AI models for inference efficiency without prior notice or explicit consent.
Additionally, the Company's local server is exposed to the internet using tunneling technology provided by external distributed network operators to reach global users. Therefore, intermittent downtime or access instability may arise from third-party edge network routing errors or DDoS attack mitigation. The Company is exempt from liability for service interruptions caused by force majeure events including natural disasters, telecommunications line failures, or cloud network outages beyond the Company's reasonable control.
terms.ch3Title: Chapter 3 Data Localization and Strict Privacy Protection
terms.s8Title: Article 8 (Infrastructure Localization Principle and Cross-Border Data Transfer)
terms.s8Body:
The core security principle of PROOF is thorough geographic isolation of user data. Account information, Input Data, and AI Outputs collected or generated during service operation are stored exclusively in encrypted form on infrastructure physically located in Seoul, Republic of Korea, under the Company's control.
Since the Service operates over the global internet, when Users residing outside Korea upload data, that data inevitably crosses national borders to reach the Seoul servers. By agreeing to these Terms, Users worldwide provide explicit and irrevocable consent to the transfer, hosting, and processing of their data in the Republic of Korea.
terms.s9Title: Article 9 (Global Privacy Regulations and GDPR Adequacy-Based Lawful Processing)
terms.s9Body:
The Company strictly complies with the Republic of Korea's Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA) and global compliance standards. A breach response process is in place to immediately notify data subjects and competent authorities upon discovering potential data breaches. In particular, for processing data of EU citizens, the Company lawfully transfers European personal data to its Seoul server infrastructure based on the legal effect of the European Commission's Adequacy Decision for the Republic of Korea.
Due to this regulatory framework, Users must not upload sensitive high-risk personally identifiable information (PII) such as others' national ID numbers, passport numbers, detailed financial information, or health status (PHI) in raw form without de-identification. The User bears unlimited responsibility for any privacy regulation violations and fines resulting from careless transmission of such sensitive information, and the Company has no obligation to technically pre-filter or censor such data.
terms.ch4Title: Chapter 4 Self-Hosted AI Intellectual Property Policy and Hallucination Disclaimer
terms.s10Title: Article 10 (Input Data Ownership and Scope of Usage License)
terms.s10Body: All intellectual property rights in Input Data uploaded by the User belong in principle to the User or the legitimate original rights holder. The Company asserts no ownership over Input Data. However, by using the Service, the User grants the Company a non-exclusive, royalty-free, worldwide, sub-licensable right to use Input Data solely for the limited purposes of conversion, splitting, analysis, hosting, and return of results. The User warrants that the data provided does not infringe any third party's copyrights, trade secrets, or publicity rights, and bears full responsibility for unauthorized processing of documents with unclear rights.
terms.s11Title: Article 11 (Exclusive Attribution of AI Outputs and AI Model Training Exclusion Principle)
terms.s11Body:
Leveraging the technical advantages of its self-hosted engine, the Company guarantees that all commercial ownership, distribution rights, and usage rights for AI Outputs generated by Users through PROOF based on legitimate Input Data shall exclusively belong to the User. The Company claims no rights over outputs generated in the customer's private security environment.
More importantly, the Company makes a strong commitment regarding data privacy. The Company pledges never to use User-uploaded original documents or AI Outputs for any model improvement purposes, including fine-tuning, pre-training, or weight updates of its internal AI models. User data is used solely for one-time inference processes for the requested conversion task and does not enter the model's memory.
terms.s12Title: Article 12 (Limitations of Probabilistic Machine Inference and Complete Disclaimer for Hallucination)
terms.s12Body:
The User understands and agrees that PROOF's language model is an inherently probabilistic machine learning system that infers through statistical pattern matching rather than deterministic logic rules. The Company applies model compression and quantization techniques for efficient server resource allocation and improved processing speed.
Due to the mechanics of quantized probabilistic systems, outputs may contain the following structural defects: (a) hallucination phenomena adding false data not present in the original, (b) format distortion misaligning rows and columns in complex cell merges or multi-column structures, (c) random omission of specific words or decimal values.
To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, the Company disclaims any and all legal warranties regarding the absolute accuracy, data integrity, reliability, merchantability, fitness for a particular purpose, and non-infringement of third-party rights of AI Outputs. PROOF is a productivity tool that assists in drafting documents quickly; it is not designed to replace expert judgment or accounting and legal due diligence. The User has an absolute and total obligation to have a human cross-verify AI Outputs against original files before using them for important business decisions, financial statement preparation, regulatory submissions, or commercial services for third parties. The legal responsibility for losses or reputational damage resulting from failure to perform such verification shall be entirely attributed to the User, and the Company is fully exempt from liability.
terms.ch5Title: Chapter 5 API Monetization and Strict Liability Control in the B2B Ecosystem
terms.s13Title: Article 13 (API License Grant and Strict Prohibition of System Abuse)
terms.s13Body:
The Company grants API Users a limited, non-transferable, revocable, non-exclusive license to call the Service programmatically and receive results in accordance with official documentation. API Users must comply with rate limit policies and monthly data quotas allocated per subscription tier.
Creating fake accounts to circumvent limits or exceeding allowed query rates to overload servers constitutes a material breach of contract. Upon detection of such behavior, the Company may immediately throttle API keys, permanently ban IP ranges, and delete accounts without prior warning or refund.
Additionally, the following actions using PROOF's computing capabilities are strictly prohibited: first, mass-scraping PROOF's data to train competing AI models; second, repackaging PROOF's API as a similar document conversion API and reselling it to third parties.
terms.s14Title: Article 14 (Third-Party Indemnification and Broad Disclaimer Provisions)
terms.s14Body:
API Users must serve as a defense shield against legal impacts the Company may suffer from the API User's business activities. API Users shall indemnify and fully compensate the Company for all lawsuits, claims, damages, fines, settlements, and dispute defense costs brought by third parties against the Company for the following reasons.
First, where Input Data uploaded by the API User infringes a third party's intellectual property rights or violates applicable laws. Second, where AI Outputs containing hallucinations are provided to end consumers without filtering through the API User's application, causing losses and resulting in lawsuits against the Company as the source provider. Third, where the API User materially violates system abuse prohibitions or privacy regulations, destroying the Company's service availability or damaging its reputation.
However, if the API User is a government entity, this provision may apply on a limited basis within the scope permitted by the highest law of the relevant jurisdiction.
terms.ch6Title: Chapter 6 Comprehensive Liability Limitation, Export Control, and Dispute Resolution
terms.s15Title: Article 15 (Export Control and Compliance with International Sanctions Regulations)
terms.s15Body:
PROOF is an AI technology service deployed in a global environment and is subject to U.S. export control laws, the Republic of Korea's Foreign Trade Act, and export control and sanctions regulations of other jurisdictions. By agreeing to these Terms, the User certifies that they do not reside in a weapons-embargoed country or a UN-sanctioned country and is not listed on sanctions party lists published by relevant government agencies.
The User may not transfer, assign, lend, or provide remote access to the Service's processing capabilities or generated data to sanctioned countries or prohibited entities. The Company reserves the right to immediately suspend service performance and permanently terminate the contract if there is reasonable suspicion of violations of international sanctions or export restriction regulations.
terms.s16Body:
Under no circumstances shall the Company be legally or financially liable for punitive, incidental, indirect, consequential, or special damages including loss of profits, loss of anticipated profits, data destruction, or business interruption arising from the use of, inability to access, or reliance on outputs containing hallucinations from the Service. This applies even if the Company has been warned or could have foreseen the possibility of such damages.
Even in exceptional cases where the Company is held liable for damages under these Terms or mandatory provisions, the Company's total cumulative liability shall not exceed the total amount of PROOF service fees paid by the User in the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to the claim. This provision shall survive termination of the contract.
terms.s17Title: Article 17 (Contract Termination, Permanent Data Deletion, and Survival of Provisions)
terms.s17Body:
The User may terminate the contract (withdraw membership) at any time through the account settings dashboard. Refunds of paid fees or remaining credits upon withdrawal shall be handled in accordance with the separate refund policy. The Company may terminate the contract if the User materially breaches obligations and fails to cure within 30 days of notice. However, in emergency situations involving clear security threats or legal violations, access may be immediately suspended.
Upon contract termination, the User's access rights are extinguished. The Company shall permanently delete the User's profile information and data using unrecoverable methods, except for payment ledgers or access logs that must be retained by law. Following contract termination, the intellectual property policy (Articles 10, 11), hallucination disclaimer (Article 12), indemnification (Article 14), liability limitation (Article 16), and dispute resolution (Article 18) provisions shall permanently survive.
terms.s18Body:
These Terms are governed exclusively by the laws of the Republic of Korea, where the Company's headquarters is located. Renvoi to another country's laws under conflict of law rules is expressly excluded.
Any disputes or litigation arising between the Company and the User regarding the PROOF Service shall be subject to the exclusive and sole agreed jurisdiction of the Republic of Korea Seoul Northern District Court or other Seoul-area courts with jurisdiction under relevant civil procedure regulations, where the Company's principal office is located in Gangbuk-gu, Seoul. By agreeing to these Terms, global Users voluntarily submit to the personal jurisdiction of the Seoul courts of the Republic of Korea and permanently waive the right to seek transfer of the forum based on the doctrine of forum non conveniens.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.body:
This Refund Policy outlines the conditions and procedures for refunds on credits purchased through the PROOF service operated by Teamcat. The Paddle Buyer Terms and Refund Policy also apply to your purchase.

1. Unused Credit Refunds
Credits that have not been used within 14 days of purchase are eligible for a full refund. Refunds will be returned to the original payment method used for the purchase.

2. Used Credits
Credits that have already been used for service conversions are non-refundable. Credits are not eligible for refund after 14 days from the purchase date, regardless of usage.

3. How to Request a Refund
To request a refund, please email admin@proof.teamcat.app or submit a refund request through your account settings page. Please include your account email and the refund amount in your request.

4. Refund Processing Time
Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days of receiving the request. Additional time may be required for the funds to appear in your account depending on your payment method.

5. Disputing a Charge
If you have concerns about a refund, you may raise a dispute through Paddle customer support (https://www.paddle.com/).

6. Legal Rights
This Refund Policy does not limit any statutory consumer refund rights granted by your jurisdiction. EU residents have the right of withdrawal within 14 days of purchase.

privacy.title: PROOF Global Master Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Teamcat (hereinafter "the Company" or "we") considers your personal information to be our most important asset and operates our services based on transparency and security. This policy has been prepared in strict compliance with major global data protection laws, including the Republic of Korea's Personal Information Protection Act (PIPA), the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), the U.S. State of California's Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA/CPRA), and Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI). This Privacy Policy transparently guides you through the detailed procedures and standards regarding what personal information the Company collects, how it is used, and how it is securely protected when you use the PROOF web application and monetized Application Programming Interface (API) services (hereinafter "the Service").
privacy.s1Body:
All legal responsibility and authority for the processing of personal information in this Service resides with the following individual business owner.
- Business Name (Data Controller): Teamcat (Individual Business Owner)
- Business Address: 4F, Cheongdo Building, 443-98 Beon-dong, Gangbuk-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
- Data Protection Officer (DPO) and User Inquiry Email: Teamcat Representative (admin@proof.teamcat.app) (Under applicable laws, if no separate officer is designated, the business owner or representative serves as the Data Protection Officer.)
- Official Service Domain: proof.teamcat.app
privacy.s2Title: Article 2 (Categories of Personal Information Collected and Collection Methods)
privacy.s2Body:
The Company collects only the minimum personal information necessary to provide the Service through lawful and fair means. The categories of data collected are divided into information you provide directly and information automatically generated during your use of the Service.

1. Information You Provide Directly
- Account and Identification Information: Email address for registration and service login, password (stored with one-way encryption), and optionally provided name or nickname.
- Payment and Commercial Information (when using API and paid plans): Payment history, transaction information, and subscription status records. Payment processing is conducted through a thoroughly security-verified external payment gateway (PG), and complete credit card numbers or financial information are not stored on our servers.
- Service Input Data: Various formats of PDF documents, audio, video, image files, and text prompts that you voluntarily upload for the core function of structured table conversion. Since we do not pre-screen the contents of these files, you are responsible for not uploading files containing third parties' sensitive personal information without lawful authority or the data subject's explicit consent.

2. Technical and Usage Data Automatically Collected During Service Use
- Log and Device Information: Internet Protocol (IP) addresses, browser type and version, operating system environment, access timestamps, in-service interaction records, and Application Programming Interface (API) call logs (system usage records) collected to ensure service stability.
- Security and Network Data: Network traffic characteristics and metadata passing through Cloudflare tunneling infrastructure for malicious bot detection and Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attack prevention.
privacy.s3Title: Article 3 (Purpose and Legal Basis of Personal Information Processing)
privacy.s3Body:
The Company processes collected personal information only within the scope of pre-notified purposes, and if the purpose changes, we take necessary legal measures such as obtaining separate prior consent from the data subject in accordance with applicable laws. The specific processing purposes and legal bases (particularly under GDPR Article 6) are as follows.

- Service Provision and Contract Performance: Performing structured data conversion of PDF and media files requested by users, processing API call responses, account creation and user authentication, and supporting download of derived results (CSV, MD, XLSX). (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b) - Contract performance)
- Payment Processing and Settlement: Billing based on paid API usage, credit card payment and authorization, electronic receipt issuance, and tax reporting support. (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b, c) - Contract performance and legal obligation)
- Service Quality Improvement and Infrastructure Security: Application error log analysis, conversion quality improvement research, illegal use (abuse) monitoring and prevention, and maintaining server and network security status using Cloudflare. (GDPR Art. 6(1)(f) - Legitimate interest)
- Customer Support and Dispute Resolution: Responding to inquiries via email (admin@proof.teamcat.app), receiving and processing complaints, and investigating Terms of Service violations. (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b, f) - Contract performance and legitimate interest)

※ AI Processing Mechanism and Absolute Privacy Guarantee Principle: The most important differentiator of the PROOF service is that we do not transmit your uploaded document and media data to external commercial Artificial Intelligence Application Programming Interfaces (APIs, such as OpenAI or Anthropic) for analysis. All conversion and analysis processes are performed exclusively on independent local AI servers physically controlled and directly managed by Teamcat inside our Seoul, Republic of Korea headquarters. Therefore, the possibility of your sensitive business data or personal information being unauthorizedly used for third-party AI model training or leaked to external clouds is fundamentally blocked at the architecture level.
privacy.s4Body:
The Company, in principle, destroys personal information without delay once the collection and usage purpose is achieved, preventing unnecessary data accumulation. However, minimum retention periods required by applicable laws or for smooth service operation follow the standards below.

- Member Registration Information: Destroyed immediately upon user withdrawal request. (However, only a one-way hash of the email address is retained for 6 months to prevent abuse through repeated re-registration, then permanently deleted.)
- Service Input Data (Uploaded Files) and Conversion Results: Temporarily retained for 7 days after the structuring process is completed so users can download results, then automatically permanently deleted by system scripts. If a user explicitly clicks the 'Delete' button in the dashboard, data is destroyed immediately without waiting.
- Payment and Transaction Records: Stored separately in a secure database for the strict mandatory retention period under each country's tax and e-commerce laws (e.g., 5 years in the Republic of Korea), then destroyed upon expiration.
- Access Log Data (IP addresses, etc.): Retained for 90 days for security incident response, communications secrecy obligation compliance, and service performance improvement, then destroyed.
- Secure Deletion Methods: Personal information stored in electronic files is permanently deleted using technical methods (secure deletion algorithms) that make file recovery and restoration impossible, and any printed personal information documents are physically shredded using a paper shredder.
privacy.s5Body:
Except with your explicit prior consent or as specifically required by law, we absolutely do not 'sell' collected personal information to third parties for monetary compensation or 'share' it for targeted marketing purposes. However, for stable global service provision and advanced system infrastructure maintenance, we entrust minimal information processing to the following security-verified professional sub-processors.

- Supabase (Storage and Database Infrastructure Hosting): Encrypted storage of user member information, system activity logs, temporary uploaded files, and conversion results. Physical location: Seoul, Republic of Korea (using AWS Seoul region infrastructure).
- Cloudflare (Global Network Routing and Security Firewall Service): Global Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) protection, Secure Sockets Layer (SSL/TLS) tunneling maintenance, malicious bot shield operation based on IP addresses and metadata, and security log analysis. Cloudflare does not persistently store payload original data and faithfully performs its routing role. Physical location: Globally distributed edge network (Cloudflare global infrastructure).

The Company regularly inspects and fulfills ongoing supervisory obligations to ensure that sub-processors process personal information safely and do not use it unauthorizedly, in accordance with applicable laws when entrusting contracts.
privacy.s6Title: Article 6 (International Data Transfer and Global Data Flow Notice)
privacy.s6Body:
PROOF's main application servers, core database (Supabase), and AI inference server clusters are all located solely in Seoul, Republic of Korea. Therefore, data from users accessing the service from outside Korea (EU, US, Japan, etc.) is inevitably transferred to and processed in the Republic of Korea via network. We lawfully perform such international transfers in accordance with each country's laws.

- Notice for EU and UK Residents (Lawful Transfer Based on Adequacy Decision): The Republic of Korea received an official GDPR adequacy decision from the European Commission (EC) on December 17, 2021, recognizing it as a safe country. Accordingly, personal information of EU residents can be lawfully transferred to the Company's Seoul servers in Korea without executing complex protective measures such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC). Teamcat strictly complies with the Republic of Korea's Personal Information Protection Commission's 'Supplementary Regulations under the EU Adequacy Decision' to protect European citizens' personal information at a level fully equivalent to their home country.
- Notice for Japanese Residents (APPI-Based Consent Transfer): Japan has also mutual adequacy decisions with the EU and is recognized as having a safe data protection regime. Under the international transfer provisions of Japan's Act on the Protection of Personal Information (APPI), when a Japanese resident agrees to this policy upon service registration, such agreement is deemed sufficient notification and explicit consent to transfer data to servers in Seoul, Republic of Korea, and is processed lawfully.
- Right to Refuse International Transfer (to Korea) and Limitations: Users who do not wish their data to be transferred to the Republic of Korea may refuse data transmission by canceling service registration or withdrawing their account. We ask for your understanding that it is currently technically impossible to preserve data in an overseas local location while using the AI conversion features in Seoul.
privacy.s7Title: Article 7 (Universal Data Subject Rights and Exercise Methods)
privacy.s7Body:
The Company guarantees equal and strong data subject rights to all users, regardless of physical residence or nationality, by applying the highest global privacy standards. You may freely exercise the following rights at any time by sending an email to our official channel at admin@proof.teamcat.app.

- Right to Access: You may request transparent access to and copies of the types and processing details of personal information we process about you.
- Right to Rectification: If stored personal information is inaccurate or incomplete, you may request immediate correction or supplementation.
- Right to Erasure ("Right to be Forgotten"): Under certain conditions such as consent withdrawal or purpose achievement, you may request permanent deletion of all your personal information from our servers. (Most quickly, users can directly execute withdrawal and deletion immediately through the account settings menu in the system dashboard.)
- Right to Restrict / Object: You may object to or request temporary processing restrictions on specific-purpose information processing based on the Company's legitimate interests, for reasonable grounds.
- Right to Data Portability: To prevent platform lock-in, you may request to download information you provided in a universal, standardized machine-readable format (e.g., JSON), or, where technically feasible, request direct transfer to another service provider you designate.

Upon receiving a rights exercise request email, we will safely verify your identity (through account email reply authentication, etc.), then promptly process your request and provide detailed results within the statutory period specified by applicable laws (generally within 1 month under EU regulations, within 45 days under California law).
privacy.s8Title: Article 8 (Additional Consumer Rights Notice for California Residents - CCPA/CPRA)
privacy.s8Body:
California residents are protected by the Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and its successor amendment, the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), and accordingly are guaranteed the following strong and specific rights in addition to general rights.

- Permanent Prohibition Declaration on Data Sale and Marketing-Purpose Sharing (Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information): Teamcat (PROOF) clearly states that we have never 'sold' users' personal information to third parties for monetary or other valuable consideration in the past 12 months, nor have we ever 'shared' it for customized targeted advertising. Our business model is strictly based on providing technical conversion services, and we will never sell user data to brokers under any circumstances.
- Right to Limit Use of Sensitive Personal Information: We do not intentionally collect statutory 'sensitive information' such as race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, genetic data, or precise geolocation. Even if such content is incidentally included in documents (PDFs, etc.) uploaded for conversion purposes, it is processed mechanically and temporarily solely for the single purpose of providing the 'structured data conversion service' explicitly requested by the user, and is never used for profiling or targeting purposes.
- Non-Discrimination Policy: We solemnly guarantee that we will not impose any disadvantage or discriminatory treatment, such as unfairly raising service prices, degrading conversion quality or service levels, or restricting access, because you actively exercised your legally guaranteed privacy rights.
- Right to Opt Out of Automated Decision-Making Technology (ADMT): Our service does not independently perform any type of automated profiling decision that affects your legal or significant life interests, such as credit evaluation or employment rejection, based on data you submit.
privacy.s9Title: Article 9 (Special Privacy Protection Policy for Children and Minors)
privacy.s9Body: The PROOF service is primarily a complex business data conversion service and does not target children under 14 (or under 13 or 16 in some jurisdictions such as the EU, as required by law) as its main user base, nor do we intentionally collect personal information from these children. If we become aware that a child has registered in violation of age restrictions or that a child's personal information has been collected without valid prior consent from a legal guardian (parent, etc.), we will immediately suspend the child's account and permanently destroy all collected information from our servers to fulfill our legal obligations.
privacy.s10Title: Article 10 (Operation of Cookies, Web Beacons, and Similar Tracking Technologies)
privacy.s10Body:
We inevitably use certain 'cookies' and browser session information technologies for smooth technical operation of the service, user authentication maintenance, and defense against serious security threats.

- Strictly Necessary Cookies: These cookies are absolutely essential for providing core security functions and normal operation of the service, including stably maintaining your login status and protecting the system from DDoS attacks through bot detection solutions such as Cloudflare Turnstile. Please note that these cookies cannot be arbitrarily disabled by users due to their technical necessity.

As stated in the third-party provision clause, we do not use any third-party cookies for targeted advertising (Marketing) purposes to continuously track your web browsing activities and provide them to external advertising networks or marketing agencies, nor do we insert related scripts into our website.
privacy.s11Title: Article 11 (Security Measures and Strong Protection Safeguards)
privacy.s11Body:
The Company applies a composite of management, technical, and physical protective measures at levels exceeding industry standards to most safely protect your valuable data from various internal and external threats.

- Full-Span Data Communication and Storage Encryption: All network communications between your browser and our servers are strongly encrypted end-to-end through a secure tunnel (Cloudflare Tunnel) using the highest-level HTTPS/TLS protocols. Additionally, passwords and sensitive core authentication information stored in the database are protected with strong one-way hashing algorithms (such as Bcrypt) that even administrators cannot decrypt.
- Third-Party AI Model Exposure Blocking System: As detailed in the introduction, we have completely eliminated the structure of 'unauthorized transmission of user data to external cloud AI Application Programming Interfaces (APIs),' which is one of the most serious security threats in the current AI industry. All content of PDF documents and media files uploaded by users is scanned, inferred, and processed exclusively within a closed local network built inside Teamcat's headquarters using our own AI models, without external communication, and is then discarded.
- Strict Access Control and Insider Privilege Management: The number of internal staff who can directly handle and access the personal information database is strictly limited to the minimum necessary for business purposes. Even authorized staff must pass through thorough multi-factor authentication (MFA) and security log monitoring to access the system, and regular security training is mandatory.
privacy.s12Title: Article 12 (Privacy Policy Amendment and Notice Procedures)
privacy.s12Body: The details of this Privacy Policy may change from time to time due to new enactments and amendments of laws in each jurisdiction, and additions and enhancements to our service architecture. When additions, deletions, or modifications to policy content occur, the Company will provide detailed advance notice of the reasons and specifics at least 7 days before the official effective date through the announcement board on the website dashboard to prevent infringement of data subject rights. However, if amendments of a nature that significantly affects the purpose of collection or users' rights occur, we will notify you individually by email (sent from admin@proof.teamcat.app) at least 30 days before implementation to ensure sufficient time to exercise your right to refuse.
privacy.contactBody: For inquiries related to personal information, please contact us at the following email.
